title: Alysia SMP
description: Alysia SMP Vanilla+ Client side modpack!
body:
# Alysia SMP!

Alysia SMP aims to be an LGBTQ+ friendly survival vanilla+ multiplayer community devoted to having fun together. We're focused on player communication and having a player-driven server.

We're slightly modded, but every mod we added was chosen for one reason: to encourage socializing and having fun together. That means things like:

* Proximity voice chat
* Farmer's delight (And other cooking mods)
* QoL mods, such as Jade and JEI.
* Custom skill trees

All of the mods are meant to encourage socialization and adjust small things that are either broken in minecraft or could be better! **Nothing too big in terms of mods, don't worry.**

Our server is whitelist only to add an extra step to ensure that all of our players are here for the right reasons and don't want to troll.

If this seems good for you, feel free to join at [discord.alysia.live](discord.alysia.live)!
